company.name: Enact Intelligence
company.summary: 总部位于苏黎世的Physical AI初创公司，正在构建不仅能看见环境、还能在交互时感知力与触觉的机器人，通过自研执行器、传感器与模型重构机器人技术栈。

evidence_refs.quote: Founded in March 2026 by Manuel Yves Galliker, Enact is building robots that can not only see their environment but physically sense what is happening when they interact with it.
Enact’s twelve-person team draws its engineering talent from DeepMind, 1X, Amazon Robotics, Helsing, Physical Intelligence and ETH Zurich.
Enact Intelligence, a physical AI startup headquartered in Zurich, has come out of stealth today with a €26.68 million ($30 million) pre-Seed funding round
Enact Intelligence builds robots that go beyond vision by sensing force and touch through a whole-body proprioceptive system, for industrial tasks and other real-world work.

products.name: 力触觉感知机器人系统
products.description: 从执行器内部直接采集高精度力数据，构建覆盖全身的本体感知“神经系统”，并以AI模型作为“皮层”解读信号、控制动作；自研执行器、传感器与模型，可适配从单臂到全尺寸人形的不同形态。
products.target_customers: 制造业、基础设施、零售和食品加工等行业的工业合作伙伴
features: 从执行器内部采集力数据，而非依赖单点力传感器
全身力感知，覆盖至指尖
复用视频模型等现有模型并适配输出机器人动作
通过遥操作采集演示数据

evidence_refs.quote: Enact’s robots capture force data directly from the actuators themselves, similar to how humans sense tension through their muscles rather than solely through their fingertips.
A proprioceptive "nervous system" senses force across the robot's whole body, down to the fingertips, and a "cortex" is the AI model that interprets those signals and controls movement.

investment_rationale.speaker: Dr. Harald Nieder
investment_rationale.rationale: 认为灵巧操作是机器人下一前沿，Enact以自研执行器的高精度力数据作为新数据模态，从硬件向上重构整个技术栈，并借正交数据改进现有模型、构建数据护城河。
investment_rationale.quote: Dexterity is the next frontier in robotics, and Enact is tackling it with a new data modality: starting with high precision force data from bespoke actuators they are rethinking the entire stack from the hardware up. We are very excited about Enact’s approach of leveraging orthogonal data to improve existing models and build a data moat

analysis.capital_judgment: 资本押注的核心变量是：从执行器内部采集高精度力数据这一新数据模态，能否让机器人在多品种、小批量的工业终装配中实现可靠灵巧操作，并形成可复用的数据护城河。当前已验证信号仅为大额pre-Seed融资、12人团队及来自DeepMind、1X、Physical Intelligence等的工程背景；来源明确公司尚未披露估值、独立测量的操作性能、已签约商业客户或演示视频，首轮工业部署仍属计划，因此融资依赖的是团队与技术路径叙事而非商业化实绩。
validated_signals: 完成€26.68 million（$30 million）pre-Seed融资，投资方含redalpine、Notion Capital、firstminute capital及Arthur Mensch、Yann LeCun、Andrew Lonsberry等天使
12人团队，成员来自DeepMind、1X、Amazon Robotics、Helsing、Physical Intelligence和ETH Zurich
创始人Manuel Yves Galliker曾任1X NEO人形机器人软件团队负责人并在Physical Intelligence工作
公司已与制造业、基础设施、零售和食品加工领域的欧洲企业进行洽谈
risks: 来源明确公司尚未披露独立测量的操作性能、周期时间或演示视频，力触觉方案的实际效果仍待验证
尚未披露已签约商业客户，首批工业部署为计划而非已完成
来源称其进入的领域已有Physical Intelligence、Neura Robotics、RobCo、Agile Robots、Gravis Robotics等公司，且Eka Robotics同周以14.5亿美元估值融资1.5亿美元，竞争与资本密度高
